grounded_claims.claim: Latest corrected kit revision 2 remains awaiting owner MATLAB rerun.
17/17 existing preflight groups and 20/22 relay-custody groups passed on MATLAB R2025a 25.1.0.2943329 PCWIN64; both failed groups are the same queue-limit fixture bug; network never started.

Constructor nargin guards were wrong by one because obj is an output. Revision 2 changes only RelayCustodyProbe, relayCustodyPreflight, README and FILES versus returned kit. No network code/runner/reference changes.

Prior seed132 replay reached 895.115s; first observed physical payload mismatch originated in native-only second relay enqueue at 694.821813632s. Unique admitted/delivered/unresolved totals before stop are1582/1229/353 with matching first delivery timestamps.

Latest measured full autonomous +/-20% target not met:5/9 defined source-seed cells pass both metrics;3 native-zero cells remain undefined/population mismatches. Weighted delivered latency gap+40.7025128612%, raw+102.9699562105%. These are pre-relay-repair results.

The standardized26.251732649s latency gap decomposes into+26.197863248s NWK wait,-0.252737119s initial MAC wait,+0.306606520s after first TX. This is descriptive and does not exclude upstream influence of MAC/HOP.
Historical short-v2 common-input gates passed seed1310-200s and seed1320-400s, but are not current repaired-model acceptance.
